anomalies.impact: A 10 MΩ pull-up is three orders of magnitude too weak to charge the SDA bus capacitance within the I2C timing budget and provides poor noise immunity; the SSD1306 I2C bus will not pull SDA high reliably, so the OLED display communication fails or is intermittent.
